commit.message:
fix(mep): Don't get CM for CLS (#38961)

- This fixes a bug where we went to the custom measurement map for cls
cause it wasn't a known measurement
- This also catches failures of the map to avoid this hard breaking
queries in the future, but still throws an exception so we know if
there's other gaps
